title: Bigin search misses a record created or edited a minute ago
symptoms: Search returns 204 or no match for a record visible in the app
The same search finds it a few minutes later
cause: The search index lags writes by one to two minutes.
fix: Do not treat an immediate search miss as proof the record is absent. Read by id when you have it, or retry after a couple of minutes.
apply: GET /bigin/v2/Contacts/{id} when the id is known; otherwise retry the search after 2 minutes
affected: Bigin API v2 search, July and October 2026
